items.label: Copy answers from a previous completion of the same questionnaire

admin/data_exports.title: Data Exports
admin/data_exports.description: The links under the header "File" provide access to the most recently generated data export. This export is created at night and therefore contains all the questionnaires that were completed before last midnight. You can find the codebooks in the downloaded file under the subfolder "codebooks".

admin/integration/index.title: Integration
admin/integration/index.description: RoQua has two integration methods: the HTTP API by which our application is made accessible through programming, and the single sign-on links with which your users in RoQua can log in without manual authentication.

admin/other/dossier_epd_id_changes.title: Dossier number change
admin/other/dossier_epd_id_changes.description: Occasionally, an existing client dossier receives a new client number within the EPR, or a client accidentally was assigned two client numbers, and the data from both have to be merged.

admin/overview.title: Overview
admin/overview.description: On this page you can see a number of statistics regarding your RoQua data set.

admin/rom_config/invitation_templates.title: Invitation templates
admin/rom_config/invitation_templates.description: Here you can edit the templates that are used to invite a patient or other respondent.

admin/rom_config/prefillers/index.title: Prefillers
admin/rom_config/prefillers/index.description: Within a protocol it is possible to prefill some answers, when a professional completes the questionnaire. We currently support two ways of calculating the prefilled answers:

admin/rom_config/questionnaires.title: Questionnaires
admin/rom_config/questionnaires.description: You can find an overview of all questionnaires implemented within RoQua on this page. Here, you can also find whether a questionnaire requires a license or whether it is free to use. This overview does not take into account special arrangements that you may have made with the rights holders of licensed questionnaires.

admin/rom_config/report_templates.title: Report templates
admin/rom_config/report_templates.description: Here you can adjust the templates used for generating reports. With reports it is possible to combine the results of different questionnaires in one document. For example, you could place the outcomes of a questionnaire completed by different respondents underneath each other for comparison. Once a template has been created, employees can generate reports via the RoQua EPR interface for a selection of completed questionnaires..

admin/settings.title: Settings
admin/settings.description: Here you can make some settings for the RoQua application such as the display of a link to the manual in the RoQua interface and whether practitioners will be asked for their personal information when they first use RoQua. You can also specify after which period prepared questionnaires receive a red label and which export format is used for sending ORU messages.

admin/users.title: Users
admin/users.description: Using this interface you can maintain the RoQua user accounts. We have two types of account: admin users and EPR users.

epd/client-portal-login.title: Client respondent login
epd/client-portal-login.description: Respondents can also log in via a password on the client portal. This brings additional benefits, such as viewing completed questionnaires and reports. However, this option is not checked by default. To enable this, it must be set in the organization settings of your organization.

epd/first_use.title: First use
epd/first_use.description: When you first open RoQua from the EPR, you will be asked to enter your personal details. Your name data can be used within the application to generate letters and invitations to the patient.

epd/measure/automatic_protocols.title: Auto-protocols
epd/measure/automatic_protocols.description: In addition to manual measurements, a protocol can also contain auto-protocols.

epd/measure/index.title: Preparing questionnaires
epd/measure/index.description: At the top of every screen in RoQua is the "New Measurement" button.

epd/measure/measurements/direct-invullen.title: Fill out directly
epd/measure/measurements/direct-invullen.description: Sometimes it is desirable to be able to complete a questionnaire directly on behalf of a respondent. This can be done by selecting a questionnaire and clicking the Fill out directly button. A screen now appears in which you can choose the desired situation.

epd/measure/measurements/index.title: Manual measurements
epd/measure/measurements/index.description: Within a measurement there are questionnaires suitable for different types of respondents. In the screenshot above you can see, for example, that there are questionnaires for the therapist or other employee of your organization, and questionnaires for the client's caregiver.

epd/measure/measurements/klaarzetten.title: Prepare
epd/measure/measurements/klaarzetten.description: On the second screen you can specify additional options, such as sending an invitation/reminder and preparing for the future.

epd/measure/measurements/non-respons.title: Non-response
epd/measure/measurements/non-respons.description: Sometimes prepared questionnaires are not completed by a patient or he or she is not approached for a ROM measurement. The reasons for this non-response can be registered in RoQua. They will then end up in the data export.

epd/measure/notifications.title: Invitation letters
epd/measure/notifications.description: Normally you can create and send invitation letters at the same time as preparing questionnaires. However, it may be that this has not been done, and therefore RoQua also has a separate page to do this afterwards. This is under Menu -> Invitation letters.

epd/outcome.title: Outcome
epd/outcome.description: "Outcome" is generated on the basis of the completed questionnaires. Click on the -icon to view this "outcome". All completed questionnaires are listed on the left side of the screen. The "Scales" tab displays the calculated scale scores with the corresponding answers per measurement moment for the selected questionnaire.

epd/overview/index.title: Overview
epd/overview/index.description: This is normally the page you arrive at when you open RoQua. On this page you can see what still needs to be completed, what has been prepared, and what has recently happened for this client.

epd/reports.title: Reports
epd/reports.description: The "Reports" button at the top of the timeline gives access to the reporting functionality of RoQua. This makes it possible to combine the given answers or a table or graph of the calculated scale scores for different questionnaires into one document. This document can then be printed or downloaded for communication with colleagues and patients or for discussing patients in a team context. The Phamous letter to the general practitioner is an example of such a document.

features/index.title: RoQua Features
features/index.description: Some features within RoQua are better described separately, so that the normal manual does not become too thick.

features/lab-results.title: Automatically fill in lab results
features/lab-results.description: We are currently working on a change to this feature. As soon as that is ready we will write the manual for this.

features/prefill-with-prior-response.title: Copy answers from a previous completion of the same questionnaire
features/prefill-with-prior-response.description: This section of the manual still needs to be written.

features/recently-completed.title: Recently completed questionnaires
features/recently-completed.description: Employees with access to the admin interface can set a time span for questionnaires that determines how long a previously completed questionnaire remains valid. If this is set for a questionnaire, and the questionnaire has been completed within that period, then the questionnaire will appear at the bottom when preparing in a group of "recently completed lists". It is then probably not necessary to have this list completed now. How long a list is considered "recent" differs per questionnaire and sometimes also per protocol.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: In this manual we will regularly use terms that may not exactly match what is called at your workplace.

index.title: Manual
index.description: RoQua consists of several modules. Choose the module you want to work with on the left.

medo/migratie.title: Migratie van Medo naar RoQua
medo/migratie.description: Voor het gebruik van RoQua zonder koppeling met een elektronisch patiëntendossier, zoals voor onderzoeksprojecten met gezonde vrijwilligers of patiënten die bij een externe instelling in zorg zijn, maakten we altijd gebruik van Medo. Medo werd dan gebruikt om deelnemers te beheren, bulk-acties te starten of data te exporteren. De afgelopen twee jaar hebben we dit soort functionaliteit toegevoegd aan de beheeromgeving van RoQua. In de loop van de tijd zijn steeds meer nieuwe onderzoeksprojecten hiervan gebruik gaan maken. We zijn nu op een punt beland waarop het onderhouden van Medo niet langer zinvol is. Daarom brengen we alle projectbeheer samen in één systeem en sluiten we Medo.
